Reh.et: From Middle High German rē, rēch, from Old High German rēh, rēho, from Proto-West Germanic *raih, from Proto-Germanic *raihô, *raihą. More at roe.

Rehabilitation.et: Since the 18th century, borrowed from French réhabilitation, from Medieval Latin rehabilitatio.

s: rehabilitation (process of returning or assisting to return to good health and societal integration, usually of disabled or formerly sick people, or criminals)
